title: Fruit fly in the pocket
description: A fruit fly’s escape circuit meets quarterback pressure.
summary: This independent side project explores pocket collisions and approaching pressure through a simulated fruit-fly escape circuit. The original presentation contains the methods, results and limitations.

sections.title: Pocket collisions
sections.description: Tracking-based estimates of collision geometry and the room a rusher has to stop.

sections.title: Fly-inspired warnings
sections.description: A model of a fruit fly’s escape circuit applied to approaching rushers in the quarterback’s view.
